reading.name: Economic Regions
reading.text: Economic Regions contributes to Output Multiplier.
reading.definition: Count occupied settlements in this road-connected trade zone, including this one and neutral towns. Frontier and ruins break the zone. Each counts once; connecting two zones joins them. Scholar discipline. 3 counted; +3 to this Practice's Output Multiplier, capped at +6. This contribution adds to the base 1 and other multiplier sources. Base Stock yields, recipes, Research, Charge gain and capacity are unchanged.

reading.name: Monster Trophies
reading.text: Monster Trophies contributes to Output Multiplier.
reading.definition: Count monsters actually destroyed by this civilisation, by Hunt or Campaign. Neutral conquests and successful defenses do not count. Trophies survive Vassal death; they are a count, not spendable Stock. Dormant outside Warrior / Priest. 1 counted; +0 to this Practice's Output Multiplier, capped at +6. This contribution adds to the base 1 and other multiplier sources. Base Stock yields, recipes, Research, Charge gain and capacity are unchanged.
